baseline_registration: Existing broker_objects fixed 1 MiB workloads, three trials per arm, collected before functional implementation. This registration was written after baseline collection; it is an exploratory comparison, not a preregistered statistical trial.

matched_object_cells.transport: canonical encrypted TCP loopback, both actors in one process and one injected BrokerContext
matched_object_cells.order: arm order above, trials ascending, independent process per cell
matched_object_cells.acceptance: exact stopped-store readback, matching actual directional counters; retain any CPU/time loss. No concurrency speedup or WAN claim from these cells.

native_cells_registered_before_execution.profile: experimental64, existing Linux rate enforcement absent and disclosed
native_cells_registered_before_execution.acceptance: exact durable publication plus keyless reboot readbacks, matched endpoint/relay counters, aggregate transport owner high-water and zero reservations after joined teardown

regressions: Blocked application phase must permit independent service dispatch; old behavior observed RED, new split GREEN
Post-work deadline and incoming policy replacement refuse Reply preparation
Host and tenant link/frame/buffer capacity; frame retains link; checked overflow; cross-owner scope refusal
Reserve relay serialized-buffer credit before allocating/read payload; malformed/partial read and forwarding failure release after buffer destruction
resource_claim: Serialized relay buffer reservations and links are orchestrator-scoped. Endpoint plaintext, guest heap, allocator copies, kernel buffers, cache/workspace, machine-wide owner exclusion and fair scheduling remain distinct.
evidence_custody: Compact JSON/source hashes in Git; synthetic payloads and VM disks stay on Wick. Delete only successfully verified owned disposable stores after evidence hashes and readbacks are retained.
